messages:
carmen (product): Quick recap from today's call with Acme: they want predictable monthly pricing for Dedicated + a 'burst' addon for traffic spikes. They'd also like higher embedding rate limits for search. Thoughts?
ryan (sales): they're pushing for a 12 month commit, want a price cap if model swaps happen mid-term. They said competitors offered that.
anita (revops): FYI our billing currently supports SKU-based add-ons but not dynamic caps. We can implement a 'burst_credit' SKU, but metering + proration work needed.
devon (eng): Implementation caveat: burst credits are doable but need per-tenant token counters and throttles. That touches routing and cache quotas. ETA ~3 sprints.
omar (legal): we need to be careful with 'price cap on model swaps' language. Suggest: cap on token price for supported model classes, exclude third-party model surcharges.
ryan (sales): customer also asked for an SLA uplift for private deployments (99.9 -> 99.95) with penalty credits.
carmen (product): we should decide whether SLA uplift is an add-on or a higher tier. Also define launch criteria: billing support + SLO + signed DPA.
devon (eng): rollout plan: feature flags for burst SKU, per-tenant limits in the router, metering export to billing. Minimal viable would be quota + top-up portal.
pricing-bot: Summary: proposed options:
```
Option A: Higher tier 'Dedicated Pro' w/ increased limits + SLA uplift
Option B: Add-ons: burst_credits (metered), sla_uplift (flat surcharge)
Option C: Hybrid: base tier + optional SLA add-on & limited burst bundle
```
ryan (sales): preference from GTM: Option B (add-ons) closes faster and keeps self-serve funnel.
anita (revops): Option B is fine but needs billing schema and portal UX. Estimate 6 weeks for end-to-end.
omar (legal): also add clause: add-ons subject to usage caps and not eligible for refunds unless SLA triggers.
carmen (product): decision call: propose we target Option B for v1, with explicit roadmap tickets for turning burst into tier feature if adoption high. I'll draft PRD and can we get eng + revops signoff by EOD Friday? :calendar:
devon (eng): ok to scope, will surface blocking perf experiments by Wednesday.
ryan (sales): I'll push for 12-month commit, but annotate that price-cap language will be limited as Omar suggested.
carmen (product): thanks everyone. I'll drop the PRD link here once drafted. :green_heart:
